comment: Hermetic host test suites, run by host-tests.py from the top of the tree.
{output} is a fresh path that does not exist yet; its parent does.
expect: pass (exit 0, the default) or fail (non-zero; mutation checks that report a caught mutant that way).
known_failure: runs, is reported, and does not fail the job; remove it once the suite passes.
commits: history the suite reads; host-tests.py --fetch-commits fetches it into a shallow checkout.
Every test-like file under the discovery roots is listed in suites or excluded (tests/test_host_tests.py checks).
helpers: files that look like suites but are run by a listed suite.
serial: the suite measures time; it runs alone, after the parallel batch.
group: the CI job that runs the suite; aurora-sep-slow holds the longest aurora-sep suites so they run beside the rest.
